**AFDK Anbefalinger for patientundervisningen** (AFDK Recommendations for Patient Education) is a guiding report that establishes the content and structure for the structured education of patients newly diagnosed with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The document is mandated to be disseminated and implemented nationally across the Danish healthcare system in collaboration with [[sig-af|SIG AF]] [^src1]. 

Within the broader context of the AFDK 2025 report, this document plays a central role in the quality measurement of patient education (indicator 4a) and clinical outcomes. It serves as a foundational framework to address systemic challenges and improve educational interventions, integrating input from professional organizations, clinical professionals, and patient representatives [^src1]. 

Because the available corpus data for this specific document is limited to a single primary mention and relationship, further granular claims or historical timeline events are not currently documented.
